postulates.P1_INRADIUS: Metric pinning by the constructible right triangle (sqrt(2), sqrt(3), sqrt(5)) incircle diameter 2r = sqrt(2)+sqrt(3)-sqrt(5) (Math_Topology_v17 Postulate 2.7).
postulates.P2_UNIT_AU: Astronomical unit normalization r_0 = 1.0 AU as the m=0 unit length scale for the dimensionless O_h sphere ladder R(m)/r_0 = (sqrt(3))^m (Planet_9_v44 Sec. 4.1.1).
postulates.P3_SURFACE_TENSION: Topological defect boundary area scales as A(N) proportional to N^(2/3) (Math_Topology_v17 Prop. 6.2 & Postulate 6.3).

theorems.T2.1_DISC: Field discriminant of K=Q(sqrt2,sqrt3,sqrt5) is Delta_K = 2^16 * 3^4 * 5^4 = 3,317,760,000; sqrt(|Delta_K|) = 57,600 = 240^2.
theorems.T2.5_PYTH: Coupled Pythagorean closure 1^2+(sqrt2)^2=(sqrt3)^2, (sqrt2)^2+(sqrt3)^2=(sqrt5)^2 and inradius 2r = sqrt2+sqrt3-sqrt5.
theorems.T2.9_KUMMER: Square-free Kummer sieve over {2,3,5} proves sqrt(13) not in K (13 does not divide 30).
theorems.T_E8_CARTAN: E_8 root system has 240 minimal vectors and Cartan determinant det(G_E8) = 1.
theorems.T_OH_SPHERE_LADDER: For a cube of side a, circumscribed-to-inscribed sphere ratio is R_out/r_in = sqrt(3) (area ratio 3); with A_F valency tensor dimension m_1 = v_l*v_q = 2*3 = 6 and Dirichlet unit rank rk(O_K^x) = 7, the dimensionless ladder (sqrt(3))^m gives (sqrt(3))^6 = 3^3 = 27 and (sqrt(3))^7 = 27*sqrt(3).
theorems.T_OH_FCC: O_h branching {2,6,10,14} yields bicone capacities {2,8,8,18,18,32}, hemisphere sum 86, full sum 172 = 4*43, and FCC Kepler packing ratio pi/sqrt(18).
theorems.T_SUBADDITIVE: Strict concavity of f(N)=N^(2/3) implies (N1+N2)^(2/3) < N1^(2/3) + N2^(2/3).
theorems.T_GALOIS_18DEG: sin(18 deg) = (sqrt(5)-1)/4 lies in Q(sqrt5) subset K, whereas Q(cos 18 deg) = Q(zeta_20)^+ has cyclic Galois group Z/4Z of exponent 4 and cannot embed into Gal(K/Q) = (Z/2Z)^3 of exponent 2; hence cos(18 deg) is not in K and 18 deg is not an SO(3,K) rotation.
theorems.T_KPHAM_MEASURE: For prograde orbits i in [0,90 deg], K-PHAM maps (S_k,S_h) strictly into {1,2}x{1,2,3}; under uniform omega in [0,360 deg) at delta_k=0, the exact measure of S_k=2 is (5 - sqrt(2))/6 ≈ 0.597631 in K.
theorems.T_STELLA_MULTIPOLE: Cube vertices {+-1,+-1,+-1} partition uniquely by parity xyz=+-1 into two regular tetrahedra T1, T2 (edge^2=8); for the 12 cuboctahedral E-nodes, multipole moments l=1, l=2, l=3 vanish identically while l=4 is non-zero; P_2(cos arccos(1/sqrt3)) = 0 and arccos(1/sqrt3)+arccos(sqrt(2/3)) = 90 deg.

Delta_K_field_discriminant.name: Delta_K_field_discriminant
Delta_K_field_discriminant.statement: Field discriminant of K = Q(sqrt2, sqrt3, sqrt5) from product of 7 quadratic subfield conductors; sqrt(|Delta_K|) = 57,600 = 240^2.

E8_Cartan_determinant_and_roots.name: E8_Cartan_determinant_and_roots
E8_Cartan_determinant_and_roots.statement: det(Cartan E_8) = 1 and kissing number tau_8 = 240 minimal vectors (volume ratio only, not an embedding of O_K into E_8).

Kummer_wall_sqrt13_exclusion.name: Kummer_wall_sqrt13_exclusion
Kummer_wall_sqrt13_exclusion.statement: 13 does not divide 30 = 2*3*5, hence sqrt(13) is not in K = Q(sqrt2, sqrt3, sqrt5).

oh_sphere_ladder_27_and_27sqrt3_identiti.name: oh_sphere_ladder_27_and_27sqrt3_identities
oh_sphere_ladder_27_and_27sqrt3_identiti.statement: Cube sphere ratio Lambda_Y = R_out/r_in = sqrt(3) raised to valency tensor dimension m_1 = v_l*v_q = 6 gives (sqrt(3))^6 = 3^3 = 27, and at m_2 = rk(O_K^x) = 7 gives (sqrt(3))^7 = 27*sqrt(3).

FCC_kepler_packing_and_bicone_sum.name: FCC_kepler_packing_and_bicone_sum
FCC_kepler_packing_and_bicone_sum.statement: O_h capacities {2,8,8,18,18,32} sum to 86 (172 = 4*43 over both bowls), and 172 spheres of radius a*sqrt(2)/4 in 43 FCC cells fill pi/sqrt(18).

stella_octangula_and_oh_multipole_vanish.name: stella_octangula_and_oh_multipole_vanishing
stella_octangula_and_oh_multipole_vanish.statement: Cube vertices partition into T1 and T2 regular tetrahedra; cuboctahedral E-nodes have l=1,2,3 moments identically zero (first non-zero is hexadecapole l=4); P_2(cos 54.7356 deg) = 0 and alpha_magic + gamma = 90 deg.

galois_18deg_sin_in_K_cos_not_in_K.name: galois_18deg_sin_in_K_cos_not_in_K
galois_18deg_sin_in_K_cos_not_in_K.statement: sin(18 deg) = (sqrt5-1)/4 is in Q(sqrt5) subset K, but cos(18 deg) is not in K because Gal(Q(cos 18 deg)/Q) = Z/4Z has exponent 4 != 2; proves 18 deg is an algebraic echo, not a geometric forcing.

kpham_prograde_domain_and_sk2_uniform_pr.name: kpham_prograde_domain_and_sk2_uniform_prior
kpham_prograde_domain_and_sk2_uniform_pr.statement: Prograde orbits (i<=90 deg) satisfy (S_k,S_h) in {1,2}x{1,2,3} identically; under uniform omega in [0,360 deg), the exact geometric prior for S_k=2 is (5-sqrt2)/6 ≈ 59.763%.

pinned_inradius_metric_scale_2r.name: pinned_inradius_metric_scale_2r
pinned_inradius_metric_scale_2r.statement: Incircle diameter 2r = sqrt(2)+sqrt(3)-sqrt(5) derived from metric pinning postulate P1_INRADIUS.

kpham_valence_shell_radius_R2.name: kpham_valence_shell_radius_R2
kpham_valence_shell_radius_R2.statement: From R(m) = r_0 * (sqrt(3))^m with unit scale P2_UNIT_AU (r_0 = 1 AU), the m=6 neck shell is R_1 = (sqrt(3))^6 AU = 27.0 AU and the m=7 shell is R_2 = (sqrt(3))^7 AU = 27*sqrt(3) AU ≈ 46.7654 AU (evaluated prior to any catalog comparison).

subadditive_defect_coalescence_ratio_equ.name: subadditive_defect_coalescence_ratio_equal_mass
subadditive_defect_coalescence_ratio_equ.statement: For two equal defects N1=N2, E_merge/E_sep = 2^(2/3)/2 = 2^(-1/3) ≈ 0.7937 < 1 under P3_SURFACE_TENSION.

oh_outer_egg_shells_rin_Rmid_Rout.name: oh_outer_egg_shells_rin_Rmid_Rout
oh_outer_egg_shells_rin_Rmid_Rout.statement: Under unit scale P2_UNIT_AU (r_0=1 AU), the m=10 inscribed sphere is r_in=(sqrt3)^10=243.0 AU, the m=11 circumscribed sphere is R_out=(sqrt3)^11=243*sqrt3≈420.89 AU (S_out=3*S_in), and the 12 edge midpoints lie at R_mid=R_out*sqrt(2/3)=243*sqrt2≈343.65 AU.

sn2_band_Z_sqrt2_definitional_expansion.name: sn2_band_Z_sqrt2_definitional_expansion
sn2_band_Z_sqrt2_definitional_expansion.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Definitional algebraic expansion: since Lambda_1 = sqrt(3)*(3+2*sqrt(2)) already contains sqrt(3), multiplying by 2*sqrt(3) gives 18+12*sqrt(2) by definition, not a new physical law.

anisotropic_dual_sum_11_over_6_diagnosti.name: anisotropic_dual_sum_11_over_6_diagnostic
anisotropic_dual_sum_11_over_6_diagnosti.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Arithmetic sum 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 = 11/6 (and 4*11/6 = 22/3); the standard isotropic 3D cubic lattice Laplacian maximum is 12.

cuboctahedral_q2_shell_43_coincidence.name: cuboctahedral_q2_shell_43_coincidence
cuboctahedral_q2_shell_43_coincidence.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Selecting the second FCC coordination shell q=2 in 10q^2+2+1 = 43 is a post-hoc shell choice matching the bicone sum 43.

moonshine_integer_factorizations_diagnos.name: moonshine_integer_factorizations_diagnostic
moonshine_integer_factorizations_diagnos.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Integer identities 960=4*240, 744=3*248, 1728=12^3 are unused in the pipeline; 744 and 1728 are not derived from K.

muon_electron_mass_ratio_ansatz.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Evaluates 2*sqrt(N_twist^2 + D_k)*(1 + A_geom + delta_interf); depends on N_twist=103 ansatz (6.97 ppm from CODATA).

proton_electron_mass_ratio_ansatz.name: proton_electron_mass_ratio_ansatz
proton_electron_mass_ratio_ansatz.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Braid combinatorics ansatz 18*Lambda_1^2*(1+alpha/2pi)/Phi_braid = 1836.1485 vs CODATA 1836.1527.

dark_matter_to_baryon_ratio_ansatz.name: dark_matter_to_baryon_ratio_ansatz
dark_matter_to_baryon_ratio_ansatz.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Ratio Lambda_1/(sqrt(3)*|Wr|) = 5.3555; comparison with Planck (~5.4) is a consistency check, not proof.

baryon_asymmetry_eta_ansatz.name: baryon_asymmetry_eta_ansatz
baryon_asymmetry_eta_ansatz.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Phenomenological ansatz |Wr|/(N_twist * 10^7) pending first-principles derivation (DNK_Final_v7 Sec. 13.3/14.2).

GM_sun_over_GM_Jup_constant_menu.name: GM_sun_over_GM_Jup_constant_menu
GM_sun_over_GM_Jup_constant_menu.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Exploratory comparison of additive constants (+sqrt(10): 0.0067%, +(sqrt2+sqrt3): 0.0082%, +pi: 0.0087%) to match IAU GM_sun/GM_Jup.

uranus_obliquity_ablation.name: uranus_obliquity_ablation
uranus_obliquity_ablation.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Ablation test showing 98.052 deg without 1/(2*103) (Delta=0.282 deg) vs 97.774 deg with post-hoc 1/(2*103) term.

cabibbo_and_omega_lambda_ansatz.name: cabibbo_and_omega_lambda_ansatz
cabibbo_and_omega_lambda_ansatz.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. sin(theta_C)=0.2246 (0.61 sigma) and Omega_Lambda=0.6900 (0.73 sigma): compatibility checks, not proofs.

laguerre_solar_rhyme.name: laguerre_solar_rhyme
laguerre_solar_rhyme.statement: VISUAL RHYME ONLY. Structural analogy between Laguerre L_2^(0) nodal profile (mapped with 5 display knobs to x1=0.98, x2=3.60) and IT3 floor density. Not evidence, not a scaling law.

micro_macro_descent_rhyme.name: micro_macro_descent_rhyme
micro_macro_descent_rhyme.statement: VISUAL RHYME ONLY. Nuclear alpha-decay shift (Delta Z = -2) and celestial K-PHAM cascade (floor(x/sqrt3)) are non-isomorphic structural rhymes (Guard F.2).

solar_atomic_shell_interpretation.name: solar_atomic_shell_interpretation
solar_atomic_shell_interpretation.statement: OPEN CONJECTURE. Interpretation of K-PHAM S_n floors as macroscopic atomic shells.

z172_periodic_table_termination_conjectu.name: z172_periodic_table_termination_conjecture
z172_periodic_table_termination_conjectu.statement: OPEN CONJECTURE. While 172 = 4*43 is exact arithmetic, identifying Z_max=172 as the physical end of the periodic system via FCC vacuum closure is a theoretical conjecture.

stone_shield_astrometric_localization.name: stone_shield_astrometric_localization
stone_shield_astrometric_localization.statement: Empirical candidate anomaly localization near O_h E-nodes in NOIRLab/Gaia/AllWISE archives; not a confirmed solid topological body. Falsifiable by LSST DR1/DR2.

macro_compton_periodicity.name: macro_compton_periodicity
macro_compton_periodicity.statement: NULL RESULT. Macro-Compton periodicity at log(Lambda_1^2)=4.624 is not confirmed on current JFC-dominated cometary data (SNR < 0.1 sigma).

solar_core_and_gaia_vT_lambda1_ansatz.name: solar_core_and_gaia_vT_lambda1_ansatz
solar_core_and_gaia_vT_lambda1_ansatz.statement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Kinematic ratios T_J/(Lambda_1^2*sqrt3) ≈ 24.545 d and v_T = v_0*Lambda_1^2/2 ≈ 50.956 km/s (Planet_9_v44 Sec. 2.6 & Sec. 9).

catwise2020_e5_brown_dwarf_scan.statement: NULL RESULT. CatWISE2020 thermal scan at E-5 (RA 61.24 deg, Dec -30.45 deg) detected 0 luminous Y/T brown dwarfs (W1-W2>=0.8, mu>=100 mas/yr, SNR>5), constraining baryonic point-mass models (Planet_9_v44 Sec. 10.2).

solar_system_sn_observed_distribution.statement: MPCORB objects populate S_n floors with 99.44% in S_n=0 and 6,335 in S_n=2.

monte_carlo_1d_kuiper_peak_test.statement: 1D Monte Carlo test of R_2=46.77 AU against observed Kuiper peak 47.38 AU (error 1.291%).

joint_neptune_mmr_test.statement: NULL / NEGATIVE RESULT: 2D joint test against Neptune (30.07 AU) and 1:2 MMR (47.73 AU) yields 12.23% combined loss (p=0.05185).

inclination_argmax_bootstrap_test.name: inclination_argmax_bootstrap_test
inclination_argmax_bootstrap_test.statement: Empirical inclination steepest-drop argmax is 29.75 deg (200-bootstrap 95% CI [28.75, 29.75] deg; 18 deg inside CI = False).

trojan_L4_L5_epoch_matched_ratio.name: trojan_L4_L5_epoch_matched_ratio
trojan_L4_L5_epoch_matched_ratio.statement: Epoch-matched L4/L5 Trojan ratio using pure mean-longitude difference Delta lambda = lambda - lambda_J,mean(JD) (excluded 0 fallback epochs).

cometary_shared_edge_entropy_dichotomy.name: cometary_shared_edge_entropy_dichotomy
cometary_shared_edge_entropy_dichotomy.statement: Shared-bin-edge radial Shannon entropy difference H_free - H_bound on 11 identical log10(R_eff) bins (LIVE_SHARED_11BINS (SHA:e2de02b72856e2e1, identical log10(R_eff) edges + normalized efficiency)).

table1_key_outer_objects_verification.statement: Front [T1]: Empirical verification of S_n floors for Pluto(2), Makemake(2), Haumea(2), Eris(3), 2012VP113(4), Sedna(6), 2015TG387(8).

centaur_sk2_vs_analytical_prior_test.name: centaur_sk2_vs_analytical_prior_test
centaur_sk2_vs_analytical_prior_test.statement: Front [C]: Observed Centaur S_k=2 share is 60.027% vs exact analytical uniform-omega prior (5-sqrt2)/6 = 59.763% (excess +0.26%, p=0.47916).

asteroid_family_collisional_variance_tes.name: asteroid_family_collisional_variance_test
asteroid_family_collisional_variance_tes.statement: Front [D]: Main-belt cells (N>=5) have Var(S_n)=0.0 (all in S_n=0) and sigma(R_eff)=0.5729 AU, confirming collisional debris dispersion.

nea_pha_micro_shell_occupancy_test.statement: Front [3]: NEA/PHA S_n=0 population (N=43,037) dominant cell [2, 1] has 47.75% vs uniform S_k=2 prior 59.76%.
